Maya: Quick async — onboarding handoff for model 'vortex-7b-q' (smaller variant).
Maya: What I did: ran full evals on 4 prompt sets, pushed baseline metrics to /evals/run/2137, created PR #4583 with a tokenizer tweak.
Maya: Blockers: CI flaky on long-seq tests (timeout in kv-warmup), need eng-runtime help to tweak batch window; also seeing a ~4% regression on factuality for prompt_set 'legal_short'.
Maya: Today: debug CI with eng-runtime, try rolling a small quantization tweak (int8 -> int8+smear), update prompt set and notify product.
Jon: Ping @Maya — saw the regressions. Can you paste the failing sample IDs? I can try reproducing locally.
Maya: Sure — sample ids: 8721, 8724, 8730. repro command:
```bash
python tools/repro.py --model vortex-7b-q --ids 8721,8724,8730 --temp 0.0
```
Liam: FYI I merged a hotfix to the evaluator to fix tokenization boundary issue (PR #4579). Might explain some drift.
Sara: Quick question — for the 'legal_short' prompt set, did you enable the new system message sanitization? That was toggled off for previous runs.
Maya: Not for that run, good catch. I'll re-run with sanitization on and compare.
EvalBot: AUTO-EVAL: run 2137 completed. metrics: accuracy 0.926 -> 0.887 (baseline). flagged prompt_set: legal_short. top failure modes: hallucination, truncation.
Jon: If re-run improves, we can cherry-pick the evaluator fix and schedule a canary. If not, we need to rollback tokenizer change.
Maya: I'll re-run tonight at 22:00 PT and post results here. If anyone wants to pair, I'm available 21:30–22:30.
Liam: :thumbsup: I'll be around.
Sara: I'll update the prompt set doc and add the failing examples.
Maya: Thanks — will close the loop after the re-run.
